note: USFS campground in Land Between the Lakes National Recreation Area on Energy Lake, a no-wake inland lake cut off from Lake Barkley by an earthen dam. Three wooded campsite loops (A, C, D) and a cabin loop (B), with a campers-only swim beach, playground, activity field and canoe/kayak rentals. The outer sites (A6-A9, C5-C6, D4-D5) look at the lake through trees; none sits on an open bank. Pads run 20-45 ft; C5 and D3 are 20 ft. --Claude
summary: Kept, lakeview unchanged. Fees 12-28 confirmed; hookups 50A, no water at sites; 35 sites with pull-throughs; showers, dump, potable water, laundry; season 03-01..11-30; booking moved to LBL UseDirect (park 4), some sites FCFS, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, 21-day limit, 180-day window; pass discounts 50%. Note rewritten (Energy Lake is dammed off, not an embayment). Pin ~330 m east of the loops.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakeview kept): sites sit 12-50 m from the water but 3-9 m above it under continuous canopy. 3DEP vs the 109.21 m lake surface: C5 (36.85623,-88.02208, web-bookable, 20-ft pad) 112.0 m, water at 12-18 m (~2.7 m up, the closest pad); C6 (36.85627,-88.02176, FCFS) 113.6 m, water at 30 m; A9 (36.85695,-88.01953) 115.3 m at 30 m; A7 (36.85717,-88.01879) 118.4 m at 40 m; A6 (36.85720,-88.01851) 118.3 m at 50 m; D5 (36.85560,-88.02322) 116.8 m at 50 m. Leaf-off Esri imagery shows an unbroken tree band along the shore. C5 is the only pad that might pass the kayak test, but its coordinate is the reservation map's marker, it is wooded, and its 20-ft pad doesn't take a 23-ft rig.
